description: One request end to end, identified by a trace id shared by all its spans.
One operation inside a trace: a model call, a tool call, an agent run. Has ids, timing, status and attributes.
The span that started this one. Parent links turn a flat list of spans into the tree of a run.
The standard `traceparent` header that carries trace and parent span ids between services.
OpenTelemetry's standard span names and attributes for model, tool and agent operations, such as `gen_ai.operation.name` and `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`.
Recording prompts, outputs, tool arguments and results on telemetry. Off by default; opt in only where storage and access meet your data rules.
Tokens from spans multiplied by a price table you own, summed per trace, feature or customer at query time.
